ad_info.structure_source: library format F55 (Cuadrícula de 4 momentos en ilustración de línea), winning structure mv-25
ad_info.reference_style: Line-illustration 2x2 grid: the same woman in four moments, each panel framed with a dark rounded label at its top right, the small real bottle in the last panel

global_identity.color_palette: Hot fuchsia #E6177F (highlighted headline word), dark plum #2B1226 (headline, panel labels, bottom strip), white #FFFFFF (label text), bottle black #0E0E10, seal gold #D4A437 only for the registration badge border. Secondary support colors for this variation: terracotta #C8643B (all drawing lines and panel frames) and light sand #F2E4CF (background).
global_identity.visual_style: Clean editorial line illustration with soft flat skin and clothing tints, the real bottle as a sharp photographic cut-out in the last panel.
global_identity.visual_atmosphere: Calm, warm and proud: the story of someone who finally finished her plan.
global_identity.graphic_language: Light sand background, thick terracotta cross dividers, square panel frames in terracotta, dark plum rounded labels overlapping each frame's top right corner, a slim plum strip with a white pill and a gold-bordered badge.
global_identity.text_typography: Headline in a very heavy geometric sans-serif (Montserrat Black look), uppercase; value proposition, labels and strip in Poppins SemiBold / Bold look.

creative_objective: Speak to the woman who starts everything and never finishes: four moments of the same woman (Día 1, Semana 2, Semana 4, Mes 3) where her hips and legs gain curve as she keeps the plan, and how easy it is (2 capsules a day).

art_direction.design_quality: Premium, polished, modern, scroll-stopping, professionally designed, commercially strong
art_direction.visual_hierarchy: 1) The headline with 'TERMINÉ' in fuchsia; 2) the four panels read in order; 3) the bottle in the last panel; 4) the value proposition; 5) the bottom strip.
art_direction.composition_style: Like the structure: a 2x2 grid divided by a thick cross, each cell holding a framed square illustration with a dark rounded label at the top right; the headline band added on top and a slim strip at the bottom.
art_direction.spacing_and_structure: Top 0-17% headline and value proposition; 17-89% the 2x2 grid; 89-100% strip. Each panel frame leaves a margin inside its cell; labels overlap the top right corner of each frame.
art_direction.lighting_and_depth: Flat illustration; each panel suggests its own time of day with a light background tint and a few drawn details; the bottle has crisp studio highlights and a soft shadow.
art_direction.conversion_feel: The ad must feel persuasive, eye-catching, emotionally engaging, credible, elegant and commercially strong

reference_structure_analysis.layout_summary: Light sand background divided into a 2x2 grid by a thick terracotta cross. Each cell holds a square line-illustration panel with a terracotta frame and a dark plum rounded label overlapping its top right corner ('Día 1', 'Semana 2', 'Semana 4', 'Mes 3'). The same woman, drawn from head to below the knees, facing or three-quarters, gains curve in hips and legs from panel to panel; each moment has another outfit, pose, hairstyle, place and light. In the last panel, the small real bottle stands at the lower right overlapping the frame. Added by batch rules: a headline band with the value proposition on top and a slim plum strip at the bottom with the offer, 'Pagas al recibir' and the gold-bordered badge.

detected_visual_blocks.visual_function: Result hook and desire + time + deep desire

detected_visual_blocks.adaptation_rule: Hips and legs instead of belly; facing or three-quarters, never from behind; each moment on a different day

detected_visual_blocks.position: lower right of the last panel
detected_visual_blocks.visual_function: The real bottle closes the story

detected_visual_blocks.adaptation_rule: Exact batch offer, 'Pagas al recibir', registration badge

forbidden_additions: Nude or underwear bodies; the woman is always dressed with jeans
Brand names inside the panel labels
Prices, percentages, 'gratis', guarantee or free shipping claims
Stars, reviews, customer counts or names
Loose capsules, pills or an open bottle

visual_prompt: Square 1:1 line-illustration progress ad. BACKGROUND: light sand #F2E4CF. TOP ZONE (0-17%): a centered headline in a very heavy geometric sans-serif (Montserrat Black look), uppercase, one line: 'ESTA VEZ SÍ LO TERMINÉ' in dark plum #2B1226 with the highlighted word 'TERMINÉ' in hot fuchsia #E6177F. Under it, one centered line in Poppins SemiBold, dark plum: 'Caderas con curva y piernas firmes al mes 3, con solo 2 cápsulas al día, para sentirte orgullosa de ti.' GRID ZONE (17-89%): a 2x2 grid divided by a thick terracotta #C8643B cross; each cell holds a square panel with a thin terracotta frame and, overlapping its top right corner, a dark plum #2B1226 rounded label with white Poppins Bold text. All four panels are clean editorial line drawings in terracotta lines with soft flat tints, showing the SAME illustrated adult woman, 26 years old, warm light-brown skin, short pixie haircut, drawn from the head to below the knees, facing the viewer or three-quarters, never from behind, each panel a DIFFERENT DAY. PANEL 1 (top left, label 'Día 1'): her bedroom at night under a lamp (soft blue-grey tint), pixie hair messy and flat, a wide oversized t-shirt and baggy straight jeans; she stands side-on with her face to the viewer, a frustrated look in a mirror, one hand pulling the jeans waistband a full fist away from her lower back so the empty gap is visible; straight silhouette with hips the same width as her waist, glutes flat with no curve, thin straight legs. PANEL 2 (top right, label 'Semana 2'): a kitchen in cool morning light (pale mint tint), pixie hair with a thin headband, a short hoodie and medium-blue jeans, three-quarter pose holding a glass of water and smiling a little; the jeans fit a little better. PANEL 3 (bottom left, label 'Semana 4'): a city sidewalk in warm afternoon light (soft peach tint), pixie hair slicked to one side with a hair clip, a shirt knotted at the waist and high-waist jeans, walking pose facing the viewer with a hand in a pocket; hips visibly rounder, thighs fuller. PANEL 4 (bottom right, label 'Mes 3'): a terrace at golden sunset with string lights (warm golden tint), pixie hair tousled with small gold earrings, a wrap crop top and flared jeans, confident three-quarter pose facing the viewer with a hand on her hip and a proud smile; small waist, hips clearly wider and curved, toned fuller legs filling the jeans; the change from panel 1 is obvious at first glance but natural. At the lower right of panel 4, overlapping its frame, the attached product as a sharp photographic cut-out, upright, front view, about 22% of the canvas height; use the attached product image as the only source of truth and do not redesign it: a matte black cylindrical bottle about 1.6 times taller than wide with straight sides, wide mouth and no neck, a glossy hot-pink screw cap almost as wide as the body (about 90%) and one fifth of its height with a small white 'VITALABH' pattern, a hot-pink band around the bottom fifth, black label with the pink VITALABH emblem, huge white 'AGUAJE', 'COMPLEX 3 EN 1' with '3 EN 1' in pink-red, italic pink 'TRIPLE ACCIÓN' and three small boxes '200mg AGUAJE', '400mg FENOGRECO', '200mg MACA NEGRA'; label readable; not a slim bottle, not a squat jar; closed, never mirrored; matte, no rainbow, no prism light, no lens flare; no capsules anywhere. BOTTOM STRIP (89-100%): a slim full-width dark plum #2B1226 strip with, left to right: white Poppins Bold 'Tratamiento completo: 3 frascos para 3 meses', a white pill with plum Poppins Bold 'Pagas al recibir', and a round badge with a solid gold #D4A437 border, plum center and white text 'REGISTRO INVIMA RSA-0030271-2024'.
